- Septoria brown spot: yellow leaf with discrete dark spots — no match
- Soybean rust: mostly green leaf with small tan spots — no match

- All other candidates: distinctly different patterns (discrete spots, mottling, white coating, etc.)

The diffuse bronze/reddish-orange "sunburned" coloration spreading across the upper canopy leaves is the hallmark of Cercospora leaf blight.
